summary: Very diversified: 997 holdings; the top ten are only 40%.
Trades a lot: about 109% of the portfolio changes in a year.
The average holding, by value, has been owned for at least 4.9 years.
Compared with the typical S&P 500 company, its holdings are similarly priced, more profitable and faster-growing.
Copying each filing beat the S&P 500 in 3 of 9 full years.

profile.background: Founded Bridgewater Associates, one of the world's largest hedge funds. Stepped down as chief executive in 2017, handed control to the next generation in 2022, and in 2025 sold his remaining stake and left the board.
profile.approach: Macro investing: positions across bonds, currencies, commodities and shares based on how economies work, often through systematic rules.
profile.note: These holdings are Bridgewater's, not Dalio's: he has no role there since 2025. The 13F shows only a small part of its strategy (US shares).
